output.summary: The backlog growth is driven by the per-agent close quota, not demand, capacity or effort. First-contact issues rose only 4%. Agent-created split tickets rose from 240 to 3,710 a month, and customer duplicates from 410 to 2,770. Reopens rose from 6% to 23%, and the config audit log shows no reopen-rule change, so the rise is real. Agents shifted to a quick-wins filter, and complex tickets aged over 7 days tripled. The exempt Billing pod stayed stable. Headcount and hours are flat, and Payroll adds few first-contact tickets. Engineering bug backlog contribution is unquantified. Suspend the quota and classify the aged tickets. A tougher quota, extra hires now, or a company-wide Team C rule is unwise.
